crossRefs.note: There is a conspiracy of her prophets within it, like a roaring lion ravening the prey. They have devoured souls. They…
They covet fields, and seize them; and houses, and take them away: and they oppress a man and his house, even a man and…
I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?
“But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you…
who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers: these will receive greater condemnation.”
For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by…
In praying, don’t use vain repetitions, as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much…
But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.
You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?
That servant, who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare, nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,
but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given…
